comparisons.name: music-idle-light
comparisons.description: Idle display in Music's playback bar, Aqua. The Apple logo in the middle of the body is masked: the library draws no logo.

comparisons.name: music-idle-dark
comparisons.description: Idle display in Music's playback bar, Dark Aqua. The Apple logo in the middle of the body is masked: the library draws no logo.

comparisons.name: podcasts-idle-light
comparisons.description: Idle display in Podcasts' playback bar, Aqua. The Apple Podcasts mark in the well and the Apple logo in the body are masked: the library draws neither.

comparisons.name: podcasts-playing-dark
comparisons.description: Podcasts' display with an episode loaded, Dark Aqua: title, subtitle and progress line. The artwork well is masked: the capture shows the show's artwork.

comparisons.name: podcasts-playing-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: The same with the two lines of text masked as well, so that the panel, its border and the progress line are scored alone.

comparisons.name: seek-focus-start-light
comparisons.description: A seekable display with keyboard focus on the knob, moved to the start with Home, Aqua: the focus ring is drawn around the whole panel, so it is complete at the leading end, where a ring around the knob would be clipped. No capture shows keyboard focus here.

pixels.note: ring at the leading edge: --mac-focus-ring-color (50% #186af6) over the window background #ececec, 3 pt wide, 1 pt off the panel
ring at the trailing edge, the same token
ring under the progress line, the same token
ring above the panel, the same token
Home moved the knob (--mac-color-label) to the start of the line, at the body's leading edge
nothing has elapsed: the line is the remaining colour (--mac-now-playing-lcd-remaining over the body, provisional)

comparisons.name: seek-focus-end-dark
comparisons.description: The same with the knob moved to the end with End, Dark Aqua: the ring is complete at the trailing end.

pixels.note: ring at the leading edge: --mac-focus-ring-color (50% #2ba8ff) over the window background #323232, 3 pt wide, 1 pt off the panel
ring at the trailing edge, the same token
ring under the progress line, the same token
ring above the panel, the same token
End moved the knob (--mac-color-label) to the end of the line, at the body's trailing edge
everything has elapsed: the line is the elapsed colour (--mac-now-playing-lcd-elapsed, measured on Dark-Podcasts)
